newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam 1996 rice exports to hit 2.8 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam 1996 rice exports to hit 2.8 mln tonnes.

text.p: Vietnam's milled rice exports in calendar 1996 are expected to reach 2.8 million tonnes against exports of 2.15 million tonnes in 1995, an official of the state-owned Vietnam Northern Food Corp said on Friday.
Nguyen Duy Lan said in a report to the Asia rice conference in Singapore that domestic production will rise to 28 million tonnes this year from 27.4 million tonnes in 1995.
Domestic consumption will ease slightly to 24 million tonnes for 1996 against 24.33 million tonnes last year, the official said.
The exported rice has also improved in quality. Rice with 5.0-10.0 percent broken made up 72 percent of exports in 1995 from 40 percent in 1991.
Rice with 30-35 percent broken grains made up only 7.7 percent of exports last year compared with 25.41 percent of exports in 1992, the Vietnamese official said in his report.
The capacity of Vietnam's rice mills is about 14-15 million tonnes annually. Three new mills with a capacity of 90-100 tonnes a day will be built in Thai Binh, Can Tho and Soc Trang provinces.

Capital for the project will be supplied by the Danish International Development Assistance fund. The Vietnamese government has also allocated US$20 million for improvement of the rice industry in the near future.
Vietnam has emerged as one of the leading rice exporters in the world.
